The '''mind rack''' was a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] device that allowed the person placed in it to concentrate their [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]], but it caused them severe pain and could even lead to their [[Death/Legends|death]]. In [[25,793 BBY]], [[Predor]] [[Skal'nas]] placed [[Force Hound]] [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]], who was temporarily lent to him by his master [[Tul'kar]], on a mind rack so that he could project his [[Force shadow]] into the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and find the location of the [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-rich [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="Force War 3" />
